name: mirroir-mcp
description: Drive a stock iPhone via iPhone Mirroring: no Developer Mode, Xcode or WDA. LLM-free skill replay.
long_description: mirroir-mcp drives a real iPhone through the macOS iPhone Mirroring window. describe_screen returns OCR'd text with tap coordinates; tap, swipe, drag, type_text, launch_app and open_url act on the device; generate_skill explores an app and authors replayable skills. The bundle carries the native Apple Silicon server binary, so it starts without Node or a network fetch. Requires macOS 15+ on Apple Silicon, a paired iPhone in iPhone Mirroring, and the Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions for the host app.
